PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound: Hmmm… Not a one to be found…
PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish:
Hello, have you seen any POKéMON called SHROOMISH around here?
I really love that POKéMON.
PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou:
I was going to ambush you, but you had to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS forever, didn't you?
I got sick of waiting, so here I am!
PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers:
You! DEVON RESEARCHER!
Hand over those papers!
PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe:
Aiyeeeh!
You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you? You've got to help me, please!
PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua:
Hunh? What do you think you're doing? What, you're going to protect him?
No one who crosses TEAM AQUA gets any mercy, not even a kid!
Come on and battle me!
PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve:
Grrr… You've got some nerve meddling with TEAM AQUA! Come on and battle me again!
I wish I could say that, but I'm out of POKéMON…
And, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also after something in RUSTBORO.
I'll let you go today!
PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose:
Whew… That was awfully close!
Thanks to you, he didn't rob me of these important papers.
I know, I'll give you a GREAT BALL as my thanks!
PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethi: Didn't that TEAM AQUA thug say they were after something in RUSTBORO, too?
PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime: Uh-oh! It's a crisis! I can't be wasting time!
PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems: You're loaded with items. I can't give you this GREAT BALL.
PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam:
I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!
Go, go, go! My BUG POKéMON team!
PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin: I have all these POKéMON, but I couldn't win…
PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls: I caught a bunch of POKéMON. Now I'm out of POKé BALLS.
PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWith: If you take BUG POKéMON to school, you get to be instantly popular!
PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose: I can't be popular if I lose.
PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou: If you have a big BUG POKéMON, people respect you for it.
PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1:
I want a rematch when my BUG POKéMON grow up!
I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!
PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2:
I want a rematch when my BUG  POKéMON grow up!
I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!
PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown: My BUG POKéMON have grown. I'll be popular again.
PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose: I can't be popular if I lose.
PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard: You get to be popular if you have strong POKéMON, right? So, I've been training hard.
PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass:
Yo, there! Your POKéMON doing okay?
If your POKéMON are weak and you want to avoid battles, you should stay out of tall grass.
PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanati:
Sometimes, there are things on the ground even if you can't see them.
That's why I always check where I'm walking.
PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem:
Oh, neat! That's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!
You must be a TRAINER. You should try using this item.
PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanati:
It's a MIRACLE SEED. If a POKéMON holds that item, its GRASS-type moves become stronger.
Besides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are other convenient items for POKéMON to hold.
PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperienc:
TRAINER TIPS
Any POKéMON that appears even once in a battle is awarded EXP Points.
To raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the left of the team list.
As soon as a battle starts, switch it out. It will earn EXP Points without being exposed to any harm.
PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP:
TRAINER TIPS
In addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON have Power Points (PP) that are used to make moves during battle.
If a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be taken to a POKéMON CENTER.
